name: AI Assistant
description: Adds a conversational assistant to the Jellyfin web client. Each user routes their own AI provider, and the assistant acts strictly inside that user's own library permissions: it can search, recommend from real metadata, build and edit playlists, and mark things watched, but only ever as the person talking to it.
overview: Bring-your-own-provider AI assistant for your library.

name: Auto Thumbnails
description: Generates a thumbnail for items no scraper covered: the first page of a CBZ, CBR, CB7, CBT, PDF or EPUB, a video frame via ffmpeg, or the first child's image for a series, season or collection. Never overwrites artwork that already exists.
overview: Thumbnails for anything that has none, taken from the content itself.

name: Enhanced PDF Reader
description: Replaces the minimal built-in PDF viewer with a full reader: continuous scroll with lazy rendering, zoom and fit modes, go-to-page, rotate, and a page-flip book mode. Reading position is stored per user on the server and feeds Jellyfin's own Continue Reading row.
overview: A real PDF reader for the Jellyfin web client.

name: Kids Mode
description: Turns any account into a restricted, kid-safe view with one toggle. Works as an allow-list on top of Jellyfin's own user policy, keeps a per-account override list, and restores the previous policy exactly when switched off.
overview: A per-account allow-list mode that shows only what you approve.

name: Mature Content
description: Marks items, folders or whole libraries as mature using Jellyfin's native tags, then hides them through the user's own BlockedTags policy. A topbar toggle flips visibility for whoever is allowed to use it; a durable history re-applies the marks after a metadata refresh.
overview: Hide or reveal adult content with a single toggle.
